summary: Private non-profit research university in Istanbul with 22 undergraduate programmes, most taught in English. International places are capped by YÖK quota.

admissionRoutes.text: Minimum Diploma points are a guide, not a guarantee: 33 (CASE, CSSH, Nursing), 35 (Sciences), 39 (Engineering), 41 (Law, Medicine), from 6 subjects with at least 3 at HL. Predicted or final scores are used.
Koç states that, under YÖK rules, IB certificates cannot be accepted as an entry qualification. Other listed qualifications (SAT, A-levels, AP) are considered.

notes: Documents: transcripts, motivation letter, two recommendation letters, English proof, a pre-recorded video interview and a non-waivable application fee. Submit them in the portal, not by email. Request final IB results to be sent via rrs.ibo.org.

English proof: TOEFL iBT 4.5/6 (tests after 21 Jan 2026; earlier tests 80 total, 20 Writing), PTE Academic 67, CAE/CPE grade C. IELTS is not accepted (YÖK). Exempt if the last 3 school years were in a majority English-speaking country. No IB English exemption is stated.

Fall 2026 windows: Early 1 Jan–1 Mar, Regular 2 Mar–31 May, Late 1 Jun–15 Jul (extended to 5 Aug); Medicine 15 Apr–31 May. Fall 2027 dates are not published. Applications by 15 July 2026 were guaranteed housing.

Tuition for admitted international students in 2025/26: USD 38,000 a year (TRY 1.7 million) in Engineering, Sciences, CASE, CSSH, Law and Nursing; Medicine USD 59,000. 2027/28 fees are not published. All applicants are considered for tuition-only merit scholarships.

IB exemption from Year 1 courses: Physics, Maths or Chemistry at 7, up to three courses. Law needs C1 Turkish; Medicine needs B1 Turkish by Year 2 and C1 by Year 4, so check before listing them as English degrees.
